decision.description: The tax agent's decision it posts (or posted) with; absent while there is none (⚠, BILL-WHT-UNDECIDED).

held.description: A posted bill: why a payment of it waits (BILLPAY-11): no decision yet, or one since it posted that withholds at another rate, which an edit applies.
examples: the tax agent has not decided whether tax is withheld from it

nature_of_payment.description: What the payment is for, as the bill records it.

residence.description: Where the supplier is resident for tax.

tax.description: The tax withheld, in the base currency, as posting writes it (or wrote it) to the withholding tax payable (RND-WHT).
